# Predator of the Empire

Predator of the Empire is Steel Attack's third album, released in 2003 via Arise Records.
The album was rated a four out of five by The Metal Crypt, and four out of six by Scream Magazine.
Track listing
Personnel
*Dick Johnson – vocals
*John Allan – guitar
*Dennis Vestman – guitar
*Peter Späth – bass
*Mike Stark – drums
